window.title: The picture of the order
window.subtitle: {number} · {subject}
window.who: Everybody who works on this order sees this picture: the customer, the office and the floor. The customer decides it; you can set it for the customer.
window.upload: A picture from your computer or phone
window.uploadHint: PNG, JPG, WebP or PDF. A file with a price is never a picture.
window.choose: Or a file of this order (an image, or a PDF: its first page)
window.noFiles: No image and no PDF is on this order yet.
window.designHint: The design of the first line, as before.

now.design: Now: the design of the first line

held.stale: The picture changed meanwhile. Close the window and open it again.
held.gone: This order is out of your reach now.
held.uploading: Wait for the upload to finish.
held.same: This is the picture now. Choose another one first.
held.closeSaving: Wait: the picture is being saved.

refused.stale: Someone changed the picture of this order a moment ago. Close the window and open it again to see it.
refused.gone: This order is not in your reach any more. Nothing was changed.
refused.notAllowed: This file cannot be the picture. Only an image or a PDF that the customer can open: never a priced file or a size sheet.
refused.upload: The file did not upload. Try again, or choose another file.
refused.failed: The picture was not saved. Try again.
